changelog: Anti-DDoS, IPS and reputation now block new connections from their own ipsets without touching established VPN or DNS.
Firewall rules with a specific port or address are installed in their own chains and survive a GeoBlock rebuild. Default deny stays off.
DHCP relay accepts more than one interface. App Control, QoS, proxy domains, DMZ, syslog, MFA and GRE apply only when you turn them on. L2TP is no longer written as a fake IKEv2 tunnel.
